Additionally, 10(14)-Cadinene-4,5-diol is associated with Npc187158, which targets the same transporter. These findings collectively suggest a possible role for 10(14)-Cadinene-4,5-diol in modulating the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, though the exact mechanism and functional significance remain to be fully elucidated. The evidence is consistent across different pathways, but the strength of the relationship is moderate, as indicated by the final scores.
